label: Foundational beings are necessary at w, from esse distinct from essence in contingents (inference)
rule: Reductio on possible absence by B6
meaning: B6's verdict at the foundational case. A foundational f exists at w with represented esse equal to its essence; were it absent at an accessible world it would be contingent, and B6 (every contingent being has esse distinct from essence) would contradict that identity. Only actuality and esse = essence are used.
